course.learn: Third-party risk comes from vendors, service providers, contractors, and dependencies that connect to systems or handle data. Their weaknesses can become your weaknesses.
course.why: Organizations remain responsible for managing risk even when another company performs the work.
course.example: A payroll vendor stores employee data, so the company reviews contractual controls, security assessments, access, and breach-notification requirements.
course.exam: Vendor due diligence, contracts, right-to-audit, supply-chain risk, least privilege, and continuous monitoring are common themes.
